title: Truncation Preview
summary: Shows where social feeds and search results cut a post behind "…more", and warns when the key point or a link falls below the fold.
description: Preview of where LinkedIn, Instagram, X, iOS/Android notifications and Google (by pixel width) cut the text, warning when the key phrase, a link or an @mention X won't notify sits below the fold, with fixes that move that sentence up or remove blank lines.
catches: Key phrase hidden below the fold on a surface
Blank lines that each cost a whole preview line
An @mention at the start that X won't notify as intended
Key phrase missing from the text
limits: Fold positions are measured approximations; platforms don't publish them and change them
Pixel widths depend on fonts and devices
Override surfaces for your own targets
a11y: Surfaces are a tablist with arrow-key navigation and a tabpanel
Hidden content is flagged in text, not colour alone
Warnings in a polite live region
